title: Find the add-person path in every mode
when: A new teammate needs initial access
need: An org owner or admin opens Team and chooses Invite. The server selects Name/code or Email/company sign-in/Yoke account. Send a code privately; it works once for 24 hours. The teammate runs yoke connect and chooses Enter invite code. Local mode offers a team-server reachability guide instead. Only an owner may invite another owner; org roles carry to every project in the org.
surface: Team Invite form, one-time result and Invites history; public mode table.
gap: Deployed journey proof remains pending, including the project-only grant journey of scenario 05.
review: Source tests cover mode facts, local refusal, older servers, company sign-in configuration recovery and hosted Team revocation by invite_id.
